statements.status_notes: Upstream commit 5920c6ee144fffff84b62f5b479171f734f15316 (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/lib/libfontenc/-/commit/5920c6ee144fffff84b62f5b479171f734f15316) fixes the destination index bounds check in setCode() for .enc encoding files, and this package includes that fix.
